scenarios.name: Choose panel titles as the ribbon minimization mode

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the user opens the ribbon display control menu
the user chooses Minimize to Panel Titles
the Tools command groups are reduced to a narrow strip of titles
the user activates the ribbon display control
the full Tools command groups are visible
the user activates the ribbon display control again
the Tools ribbon displays the group-title strip
the user opens the ribbon display control menu
Minimize to Panel Titles is checked
the display menu closes and the group-title strip remains
the user activates the ribbon display control
the full Tools command groups are visible
